provider.name: Stable Fast 3D (SF3D)
provider.reasonNotInstalled: The official implementation needs CUDA or experimental Apple-Silicon MPS for its texture baker. Neither is available on the currently accessible machines. Installing a large isolated environment cannot make unsupported hardware viable.

officialRequirements.accelerator: CUDA, or experimental MPS on Apple Silicon; CPU is documented but the official inference path notes texture baking fails without CUDA/MPS.
officialRequirements.modelAccess: Gated Hugging Face model access and a read token are required.

executionOptions.hardware: Intel MacBookPro16,1; AMD Radeon Pro 5300M 4 GB; Intel UHD 630
executionOptions.verdict: BLOCKED: 4 GB VRAM is below SF3D's documented approximately 6 GB default, and MPS is not available on Intel macOS.

executionOptions.hardware: AMD Custom APU 0932; 15 GB shared system memory
executionOptions.verdict: BLOCKED: Steam Deck remains the Blender worker; no official CUDA/MPS SF3D route is present.
REQUIRED for a real proof: Linux or Windows with a supported CUDA GPU and at least 6 GB usable VRAM is the lowest-risk choice.
NOT SELECTED: it is unsuitable for a reliable raw-output proof because the official baking path requires an accelerator; no inference is fabricated.

recommendedLocation: External CUDA-capable GPU environment; retain the Steam Deck solely for the required Blender import and review once a raw GLB is returned.
